title: Promotion playground baskets
description: Named baskets a promotion manager can pick from when simulating a promotion in the playground. Only the parts of the basket a person curates are stored here; the basket id, business unit and simulated date are supplied at run time.

NamedBasket.description: A basket together with the name shown in the playground's basket selector.

name.description: The name shown in the basket selector. Should be unique within the list.

Basket.description: The stored part of a playground basket.

items.description: The lines the basket is made up of.

BasketItem.description: A line in the basket, matched by itemId. Identifier, price and quantity are what the promotion engine needs to evaluate it; the remaining properties let promotions match on category, on item attributes and on GS1 application identifiers.

itemId.description: Identifier of the item or stock keeping unit, as promotions refer to it.

modelId.description: Identifier of the product model — a grouping of stock keeping units that share a base design but differ in size, color or other attributes.

name.description: Name of the item, shown on the simulated receipt.

itemCategory.description: Category of the item, matched by category-based conditions.

unitPrice.description: Selling price per base unit, in local currency. For weight-, volume-, length- and area-based items this is the price per unit of measure.

purchasePrice.description: Cost price per base unit, in local currency. Used by cost-based rewards.

quantity.description: How much of this item is in the basket, expressed in salesUnitOfMeasure. Fractional for weight-, volume-, length- and area-based items.

salesUnitOfMeasure.description: The unit the quantity is expressed in: selling units, kilograms, liters, meters or square meters.

additionalProperties.description: Tenant-defined properties of the item, matched by conditions on the property id. This is the supported way to give an item a property the contract does not name.

GS1Identifier.description: GS1 application identifiers carried by the item, available to promotion conditions. At least one must be set. Dates are GS1 six digit YYMMDD values, not calendar dates; the century is resolved to within 50 years ahead or 49 years behind the current date.

bestBeforeDate.description: Best before date, indicating product freshness, as six digits YYMMDD. A day of 00 leaves the day unspecified and means the last day of the month.

expirationDate.description: Expiration date, after which the product should not be sold or consumed, as six digits YYMMDD. A day of 00 leaves the day unspecified and means the last day of the month.

AdditionalProperty.description: A tenant-defined property, referred to by its id from a promotion condition.

value.description: Value of the property, as a string. What it represents — a flag, a number, text — depends on the property id.
